figs.name: flip-flop-types-jk-to-d-and-t-conversion-diagram
figs.alt: JK flip flop converted to D and T flip flop wiring diagram
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing how a JK flip flop becomes a D flip flop with an inverter on K, and a T flip flop with J and K tied together.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 480" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Converting a JK flip flop into a D flip flop and a T flip flop</title>
<rect width="800" height="480" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Converting a JK Flip Flop to D and T</text>
<rect x="20" y="60" width="370" height="400" rx="14" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<rect x="410" y="60" width="370" height="400" rx="14" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="205" y="95" font-size="21" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">JK to D</text>
<text x="595" y="95" font-size="21" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">JK to T</text>
<rect x="200" y="150" width="120" height="150" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#5b21b6" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="260" y="180" font-size="18" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">JK FF</text>
<text x="212" y="206" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">J</text>
<text x="212" y="246" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">CLK</text>
<text x="212" y="286" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">K</text>
<text x="308" y="206" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">Q</text>
<text x="308" y="286" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">Q'</text>
<line x1="320" y1="200" x2="370" y2="200" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="320" y1="280" x2="370" y2="280" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="50" y1="200" x2="200" y2="200" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="50" y="190" font-size="19" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">D</text>
<circle cx="90" cy="200" r="5" fill="#1a2b4a" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<polyline points="90,200 90,280 120,280" fill="none" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<polygon points="120,265 120,295 148,280" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="153" cy="280" r="5" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<line x1="158" y1="280" x2="200" y2="280" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="150" y1="240" x2="200" y2="240" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="140" y="246" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="end">Clock</text>
<text x="205" y="370" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">D goes to J, inverted D to K,</text>
<text x="205" y="396" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">so J and K are always opposite</text>
<text x="205" y="430" font-size="18" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Q follows D on each clock edge</text>
<rect x="590" y="150" width="120" height="150" rx="8" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#5b21b6" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="650" y="180" font-size="18" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">JK FF</text>
<text x="602" y="206" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">J</text>
<text x="602" y="246" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">CLK</text>
<text x="602" y="286" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">K</text>
<text x="698" y="206" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">Q</text>
<text x="698" y="286" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="end">Q'</text>
<line x1="710" y1="200" x2="760" y2="200" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="710" y1="280" x2="760" y2="280" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="430" y1="240" x2="470" y2="240" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="432" y="230" font-size="19" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">T</text>
<circle cx="470" cy="240" r="5" fill="#1a2b4a" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2"/>
<polyline points="470,240 470,200 590,200" fill="none" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<polyline points="470,240 470,280 590,280" fill="none" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="535" y1="240" x2="590" y2="240" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="482" y="246" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Clock</text>
<text x="595" y="370" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">J and K tied together</text>
<text x="595" y="396" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">form the single T input</text>
<text x="595" y="430" font-size="18" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">T = 1 toggles, T = 0 holds</text>
</svg>

figs.name: flip-flop-types-jk-next-state-flowchart
figs.alt: JK flip flop flowchart deciding hold, reset, set or toggle on a clock edge
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog showing the flip flop cycle: inputs set up, the clock edge triggers a read of J and K, and Q holds, resets, sets or toggles.
figs.after_h2: How a Flip-Flop Stores One Bit
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 560" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Flip flop operating cycle flowchart with JK input decisions</title>
<rect width="800" height="560" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">How a JK Flip Flop Decides Its Next State</text>
<rect x="40" y="70" width="220" height="80" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="150.0" y="104.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Inputs set up</text>
<text x="150.0" y="128.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">J and K driven</text>
<line x1="262" y1="110" x2="318" y2="110" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<polygon points="420,55.0 520.0,110 420,165.0 320.0,110" fill="#fff7e6" stroke="#5b21b6" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="420" y="105.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Clock</text>
<text x="420" y="127.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">edge?</text>
<polyline points="520,110 570,110" fill="none" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="545" y="100" font-size="17" fill="#6b7280" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">No</text>
<rect x="572" y="75" width="200" height="70" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="672.0" y="104.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Hold Q</text>
<text x="672.0" y="127.45" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">inputs ignored</text>
<polyline points="672,147 672,175 150,175 150,152" fill="none" stroke="#6b7280" stroke-width="2" marker-end="url(#ah)" stroke-dasharray="6 5"/>
<line x1="420" y1="165" x2="420" y2="215" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<text x="440" y="200" font-size="17" fill="#15803d" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Yes</text>
<rect x="270" y="218" width="300" height="60" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="420.0" y="254.65" font-size="19" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Read J and K</text>
<line x1="420" y1="278" x2="420" y2="305" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="115" y1="305" x2="685" y2="305" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<line x1="115" y1="305" x2="115" y2="330" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="30" y="333" width="170" height="110" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="115.0" y="370.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">J=0, K=0</text>
<text x="115.0" y="394.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Hold</text>
<text x="115.0" y="418.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Q unchanged</text>
<line x1="305" y1="305" x2="305" y2="330" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="220" y="333" width="170" height="110" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="305.0" y="370.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">J=0, K=1</text>
<text x="305.0" y="394.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Reset</text>
<text x="305.0" y="418.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Q = 0</text>
<line x1="495" y1="305" x2="495" y2="330" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="410" y="333" width="170" height="110" rx="10" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="495.0" y="370.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">J=1, K=0</text>
<text x="495.0" y="394.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Set</text>
<text x="495.0" y="418.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Q = 1</text>
<line x1="685" y1="305" x2="685" y2="330" stroke="#1a2b4a" stroke-width="2.5" marker-end="url(#ah)"/>
<rect x="600" y="333" width="170" height="110" rx="10" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="685.0" y="370.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">J=1, K=1</text>
<text x="685.0" y="394.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Toggle</text>
<text x="685.0" y="418.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Q = Q'</text>
<rect x="170" y="470" width="460" height="64" rx="10" fill="#fff7e6" stroke="#5b21b6" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="400.0" y="508.3" font-size="18" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Q locks and holds until the next clock edge</text>
</svg>

figs.name: flip-flop-types-characteristic-equations-infographic
figs.alt: flip flop types characteristic equations for SR, JK, D and T with a worked example
figs.caption: Diagram by Instrumentation Blog listing the next state equations of SR, JK, D and T flip flops, with the JK worked example where Q goes from 0 to 1.
figs.svg:
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 800 540" width="100%" font-family="Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif">
<title>Characteristic equations of SR, JK, D and T flip flops with a worked JK example</title>
<rect width="800" height="540" fill="#ffffff"/>
<defs><marker id="ah" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="9" refY="5" markerWidth="7" markerHeight="7" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path d="M0 0L10 5L0 10z" fill="#1a2b4a"/></marker></defs>
<text x="400.0" y="34" font-size="24" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Flip Flop Characteristic Equations</text>
<rect x="30" y="65" width="360" height="128" rx="14" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="72" cy="107" r="26" fill="#7c3aed" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="72" y="114" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">SR</text>
<text x="112" y="115" font-size="21" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Q(next) = S + R'Q</text>
<text x="50" y="165" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">valid only when S and R are not both 1</text>
<rect x="410" y="65" width="360" height="128" rx="14" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="452" cy="107" r="26" fill="#7c3aed" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="452" y="114" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">JK</text>
<text x="492" y="115" font-size="21" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Q(next) = JQ' + K'Q</text>
<text x="430" y="165" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">no invalid state, J = K = 1 toggles</text>
<rect x="30" y="210" width="360" height="128" rx="14" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="72" cy="252" r="26" fill="#7c3aed" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="72" y="259" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">D</text>
<text x="112" y="260" font-size="21" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Q(next) = D</text>
<text x="50" y="310" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">Q copies D on the clock edge</text>
<rect x="410" y="210" width="360" height="128" rx="14" fill="#f5f3ff" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<circle cx="452" cy="252" r="26" fill="#7c3aed" stroke="#7c3aed" stroke-width="2"/>
<text x="452" y="259" font-size="19" fill="#ffffff" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">T</text>
<text x="492" y="260" font-size="21" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="start">Q(next) = T XOR Q</text>
<text x="430" y="310" font-size="17" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="start">T = 1 toggles, T = 0 holds</text>
<rect x="30" y="365" width="740" height="150" rx="14" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#5b21b6" stroke-width="2.5"/>
<text x="400" y="400" font-size="20" fill="#5b21b6" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Worked example: JK with Q = 0, J = 1, K = 1</text>
<text x="400" y="440" font-size="21" fill="#1a2b4a" font-weight="bold" text-anchor="middle">Q(next) = JQ' + K'Q = (1)(1) + (0)(0) = 1</text>
<text x="400" y="485" font-size="18" fill="#4b5563" font-weight="normal" text-anchor="middle">Q goes from 0 to 1, so the output toggled</text>
</svg>
